h1: Get an MCP server built around your own data
lead: The person who maintains the servers on this site also builds them to order. You tell us the job your team repeats. You get a server that does it inside Claude, Cursor or any other MCP client, with a test for each tool.

services.name: A custom MCP server for your business
services.short: Your API, a spreadsheet or your internal docs, turned into tools your AI can call.
scope: Wrap your API. Claude gets typed tools with clear names, and your keys stay in your config.
Put a spreadsheet or CSV behind tools that read it, check it and write back the rows you allow.
Make internal docs searchable from chat, with answers that point to the page they came from.
you_get: A SPEC.md that lists every tool with its inputs and outputs
Local stdio by default, and a hosted URL if you want one

services.name: Setup and integration for your team
services.short: We connect the servers to the clients your people already use.
scope: Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor or VS Code, set up for each person who needs it.
Hosted URLs or local installs. We pick with you, based on where your data may go.
Pro keys put in place, and a one-page runbook your team can follow without us.
you_get: Working connections, checked on a real task
A short runbook for new hires
A list of what each server can and can't touch

services.name: Audit of your MCP server
services.short: A second pair of eyes on a server you built or bought.
scope: Tool names, descriptions and schemas. Can a model pick the right tool and fill it in?
Input checks, error messages and what happens on bad or hostile input.
Secrets, file access and data that leaves the machine.
you_get: A written report with each problem ranked by risk
The exact fix for each one, as a patch where it's small

steps.title: Tell us the job
steps.text: Write on Telegram or by email. Two or three lines are enough.

steps.title: Get a fixed quote
steps.text: We reply with questions, then a price and a date before any work starts.

steps.title: We build in your repo
steps.text: You see each commit. Every tool gets a test.

steps.title: Handover
steps.text: You own the code. We walk your team through it once.

faq.q: Can you work with our private data?
faq.a: We can build against a sample or a test account, so your real data never has to leave your side.
